description:
Guess the movie from the quote, or the artist from the lyric. 272 quotes across ten genres — action, comedy, drama, sci-fi, classics, pop, rock, hip-hop, R&B and country.

Two ways to play:

• Play — take your time, build a streak, four choices per quote
• Speed Round — ten seconds on the clock, and the faster you answer the bigger the multiplier

Pick a single genre or shuffle the whole bank. Your high score is kept on your device.

No accounts. No ads. No tracking. No internet connection needed — the whole quote bank ships with the app.
promotionalText: Name that line. Beat your streak.
